Sam (docs): opened a short PR to correct the console observability examples around KV prefix filters and cost attribution. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7012
Tara (eng-obsv): glanced. what's the user-visible change?
Sam (docs): mainly: use `kv.key_prefix` in examples (namespaced field), show a tiny migration jq snippet, and clarify that prefix grouping aggregates cost/latency by prefix value which can hide per-key outliers.
Noel (devex): can you paste the minimal example so i can validate in the playground?
Sam (docs): sure JS snippet:
```js
const res = await client.fetchDashboard({
  dashboardId: 'kv-cost-summary',
  filters: { 'kv.key_prefix': 'session/' },
  includeCost: true
});
console.log(res.metrics);
```
Felix (sdk): note for the PR: TS/JS uses `includeCost` (>=v0.18), Python uses `include_cost_breakdown`. i'll open a tiny SDK sync PR to update Go/Ruby snippets.
Tara (eng-obsv): suggested wording for the doc: "Prefix grouping aggregates by the prefix value. For per-key variance, enable sampled per-key traces on suspicious groups."
Sam (docs): added that line. also added migration snippet to map old flat field to namespaced: `jq '.events[] |= (. + {"kv.key_prefix": .kv_prefix})' old.json > new.json`. and compatibility note: "Missing `kv.key_prefix` will appear as `unknown` in filters."
Noel (devex): ran the snippet in playground; UX quirk: empty prefix filter shows all groups collapsed. documented as "Empty prefix = show all groups (collapsed)" and attached screenshot in PR.
Felix (sdk): SDK micro-PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/712 (updates multi-lang examples).
preview-bot: docs preview build successful: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/7012
Tara (eng-obsv): one last nit: metric name should be `cost_per_token_usd` not `token_cost_usd`. Sam updated it.
Sam (docs): thanks all  i'll merge after the SDK PR lands and preview updates the embedded samples. planning to ship in the next docs patch. :shipit:
